criteria_results.text: A completed or unresumable session disables the textbox, Send, agent, model, permission, reasoning, Fast, and attachment controls together.
criteria_results.notes: The in-app browser reported all eight controls present and disabled on the completed fixture session.

criteria_results.text: Prepare project for agents remains reachable from the session overflow menu.
criteria_results.notes: The overflow opened and its Prepare project for agents item was visible.

criteria_results.text: Session todo items are read-only, matching the Flutter Agents inspector.
criteria_results.notes: All four visible todo checkboxes were enabled in the prototype.

criteria_results.text: Brain exposes only the controls present in the audited Flutter view.
criteria_results.notes: The Brain page exposed an enabled New memory control and opened its editor, while the audited Flutter view exposes search, expand, edit, delete, and clear-all but no create control.

criteria_results.text: Webhook receive URLs use the Flutter-derived /agent-webhooks/:id/receive shape.
criteria_results.notes: Static source comparison found the prototype uses /hooks/rhythm/... instead; this was not mutated during the browser smoke.

process_issues.description: The generated Playwright suite failed before app navigation because macOS denied Chromium Mach-port registration inside the generation sandbox.
process_issues.detected_by: All eight new Tool tests ended with MachPortRendezvousServer permission denied and Chromium SIGTRAP before page setup.

failure_output: Chromium FATAL: MachPortRendezvousServer permission denied (1100); process exited via SIGTRAP before each Tool test reached the page.
suggested_follow_up: Add parity assertions for read-only todos, Flutter-exposed Brain controls, and webhook URL shape, then run Playwright outside the restricted generation sandbox.
